novelty_basis: The literature studies the Fibonacci length for generating pairs (Knox, Fibonacci Quart. 30 (1992): period 6 for dihedral groups, consistent with D4 here); the maximum over all pairs was not compared in detail.
proof_check: computer-assisted - exhaustive functional-graph analysis of the pair maps (EXP-C16-03)
statement: Over all pairs of elements, the maximal period of x_{k+1} = x_k x_{k-1} is 8 in S3, 6 in D4, 6 in Q8, 16 in A4 and 18 in S4.
title: Maximal Fibonacci periods of small groups
